title: Cute mini pots for succulents
author: FuseDream_3D
description:
**Kit 3 Mini Succulent Pots – Remixed Model** ✨

This set has been **remixed and enhanced** from an original model, offering more strength and better print quality.

🔹 Changes made:

- **Reinforced arms**: increased thickness for greater durability.
- **Increased height**: now **60mm**, providing more space for plants.
- **Replacement of one of the pots**: exchanged for a model optimized for **better finish** and ease of printing.

🌱 Ideal for succulents, cacti, and small decorative plants, this kit combines practicality, strength, and a modern design to decorate any environment.
